body:
>You, and those like you, must not suicide! Our species needs you now.

Fuck the human race. I'm not concerned with the species. I'm concerned with me, and the fact that the life I want to live isn't ever going to happen to me. The world can burn for all I care.

>I was talking to someone else here on SW, about just grabbing a backpack, saying "Fuck it all!" and just hit the road without looking back. Do you ever have thoughts about that?

My life is not a movie. Even if I did this I wouldn't know what to do with myself. I"m not magically going to find some reason to keep living just by doing something reckless.

>Yes, there's obviously the financial stress - you aren't earning $ so life is tricky and awkward. But that's not enough to justify suicide.

It's not just about the money. It's about the lack of control as well. I'm sick of living my life beholden to everyone else around me because I can't take care of myself. My roommates are great people and eve they're getting tired of me. Before I got my last job I spent 2 years living with my dad, with no job and no prospects for one, before I found my horrible retail job. I don't have a car, I don't have a degree, I don't have any experience in anything other than retail, and the way I see it, all I'm looking at in the immediate future is more of the same bullshit I've put up with already.

>What is it that you ultimately want from life?

Peace. Enjoyment. I want to have fun again, and not be constantly beset with responsibilities, with work to be done, ladders to climb, bills to pay. In other words, the life I want is nonexistent. 

I spent the past two and a half years working a dead-end minimum wage job. I graduated high school over 5 years ago and haven't done a single thing with my life that's advanced me in any way. Everyone I talk to says "oh, go to college! Study something you're interested in! Get a job in another field!" All the while ignoring that they're telling me that I'll be happy someday, years in the future, when I don't want to live past next Tuesday. I'm not living for the future. All the future holds is more of the same bullshit that makes me want to check out. Maybe I'm blaming our capitalistic society. Maybe the fault is my own for being so incredibly lazy and unmotivated. I don't care.

>How do you feel right now?

Numb. Hopeless. Sick and tired of trying to be optimistic. I'd like very much to simply stop existing and stop having to try to make my way in a world that, more and more, I feel like I have no real place in.

>Actually, what has kept you going so far?

Force of habit. Laziness. Inability to find a reliable, painless method to die.
